# agent/package-install

Package install that fails a package check.

Installs and one-off runs of registry packages (`npm install`, `pnpm add`, `yarn add`, `bun add`, `npx`, `pnpm dlx`, `bunx`, `yarn dlx`, `npm create`) of packages that are not already declared or installed, checked with deps/nonexistent-package, deps/young-package, deps/typosquat, and deps/known-malicious before they run.

- Default level: `block`.
- Levels: ask when a package check asks, deny when it denies (a package that does not exist or is known to be malicious). Registry lookups run only when packages.online is on.
- Looks at: agent actions in hooks: commands, file reads, and prompts.
- References: [CWE-1357](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1357.html), [CWE-829](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/829.html), OWASP A03:2025, OWASP ASI04.

## Why it matters

Installing runs the package's install scripts, and models invent plausible package names that attackers then register. Checking before the install is the only point where nothing has run yet.

## How to fix

Check the name and publisher on the registry; if it is the right package, approve the install or add it to packages.allow in ubon.json.

## If the check is wrong

This check runs in agent hooks. Allow a command prefix with `commands.allow` in `ubon.json`, or set `"rules": { "agent/package-install": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
